name: IC Power Switching Regulator — buck, 36V — TO
description: Surface-mount 36V buck switching regulator ICs in the TO package family, featuring TO-263-5 and TO-263-7 footprint options.
selection_hints: A 36V buck switching regulator IC in an SMD package is required.
The design uses TO package family footprints like TO-263-5_TabPin3 or TO-263-7_TabPin8.
Selecting tier A parts such as XL4015 or 171050601 from kicad-symbols.
avoid_when: The design requires package families other than TO or non-SMD mounting.
A regulator topology other than buck is required.
